title: How many weekday-morning platform conductor shifts a week a city transit commission's spring 2027 roster pick funds under its platform crowding standard, when the busiest platforms' mid-week crowds are riders left behind by trains arriving full
subdomain: forecasting (a city subway's platform crowds forecast by weekday for a roster pick: the busiest platforms' counted crowds read as a backlog behind trains that arrive carrying their branch, built train by train from the station census and the timetable)
prompt_shape: a committed count of weekday-morning conductor shifts a week with the count on each weekday and the posting schedule, each watch-list complex's platform escalator capacity down to and up from its platforms in the morning peak, each complex's elevator-hours out of service in the autumn mornings, and a chart of the escalator figures
